result.question: Quais capitulos CID tem custo medio acima da media geral e mais de 100000 internacoes?
result.gold_sql: WITH geral AS (SELECT AVG("VAL_TOT") AS custo_medio_geral FROM internacoes WHERE "VAL_TOT" IS NOT NULL), por_capitulo AS (SELECT c."DS_CAPITULO" AS capitulo_cid, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, AVG(i."VAL_TOT") AS custo_medio FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE i."VAL_TOT" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c."DS_CAPITULO") SELECT p.capitulo_cid, p.total_internacoes, ROUND(p.custo_medio, 2) AS custo_medio FROM por_capitulo p, geral g WHERE p.total_internacoes > 100000 AND p.custo_medio > g.custo_medio_geral ORDER BY p.custo_medio DESC;
result.generated_sql: WITH media_geral AS (SELECT AVG("VAL_TOT") AS media FROM internacoes), capitulos AS ( SELECT SUBSTR("DIAG_PRINC", 1, 1) AS cid_capitulo, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, AVG("VAL_TOT") AS media_custo FROM internacoes GROUP BY cid_capitulo HAVING COUNT(*) > 100000 ) SELECT cid_capitulo FROM capitulos c, media_geral m WHERE c.media_custo > m.media;
